description: This file defines the internal class 'MembershipSystemTarget' which implements the 'IMembershipService' and 'ILifecycleParticipant' interfaces. It manages membership table updates, health checks, and gossip communication between silos in an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: MembershipSystemTarget
classes.description: A sealed partial class that handles membership management, health checks, and gossip communication within the Orleans runtime.
